verdict.rationale: INPI documents that founders can track their formalities from dashboards, see the processing progress of a request, and use a 'Suivre l'avancement du dépôt d'actes' view of past filings. That tracking sits inside the authenticated Guichet unique account rather than on public pages, and the free public register only shows registry data, not in-flight filing status. Missing for 10: public (no-login) status lookup by filing or case reference, detail on which status stages are shown, independent or hands-on corroboration that the tracking works as described.
